narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall developed across the White Mountains and areas northward on the afternoon of the 18th. Moist air supported torrential rainfall rates between 2 to 3 inches an hour, all of which fell over saturated soils. Localized flash flooding resulted where storms trained over the same locations.
ev: Heavy rain caused a washout on Corser Brook Road in Errol.
Heavy rain over saturated ground resulted in washouts on Martins Brook Road in Wentworth. Shoulder washouts also occurred on Clifford Brook Road.
Severe washouts on Perry Road and Mountain Road in multiple locations near Dead Pond cutting off properties.
Heavy rain caused a washout on Cates Hill Road.
Zealand River came out of banks resulting in evacuations at an adjacent campground after Zealand Road flooded.
Heavy rain caused the Tuttle Brook to come out of banks and cause some minor damage to the Recreational Area off Lake Road.
lsr: Delayed report. Road washout reported on Cates Hill Rd.
